l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_01_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_13_034
l2d_voice#2.Text: 今天我也，一直觉得很害怕， 但我仿佛感到你对我说了……加油

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_02_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_01_059
l2d_voice#2.Text: 我是高松灯。 请多指教……

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_03_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_13_019
l2d_voice#2.Text: 小爱音，给你这个……喝点水……

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_04_original_08_06c6f9bc919d
l2d_voice#2.Text: 小乐奈……？你、你什么时候来的……？

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_05_original_09_f74ebcbde4a1
l2d_voice#2.Text: 小立希的鼓…… 总是给我勇气……

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_06_original_05_c9c4dbb67b19
l2d_voice#2.Text: 我想说的话……全都，写在里面了

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_07_original_02_1e0f7ff2658d
l2d_voice#2.Text: 我好像，又有什么事情做得不对了

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_08_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_14_037
l2d_voice#2.Text: 向小爽世道歉……虽然我不知道该不该道歉， 但是，我确实伤害了她……
